prompt: What does the customer want to see during the presentation?
promptZh: 客戶希望在簡報時看到什麼？

options.text: A recorded tour of the training room.
options.zh: 一段預錄的訓練室介紹。
options.whyZh: 對話說用現場電腦放投影片；客戶想看的是即時訂單示範，不是場地介紹。

options.text: A list of people who are joining remotely.
options.whyZh: 對話提到遠端與會者，但沒有說客戶想看名單。

options.text: The order screen changing in real time.
options.whyZh: 女方一開始直接說客戶想在她解說時看訂單畫面即時變動。

options.text: A new set of printed instructions.
options.whyZh: 此次要看的是實際畫面，不曾提到印製說明。

explanationZh: 女方一開始直接說客戶想在她解說時看訂單畫面即時變動。
evidence: the customer wants to see our order screen change while I talk.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: the customer wants to see our order screen change while I talk.

vocabulary.note: 指實際操作訂單時使用的介面，而非預先截下的圖片。
